channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Richard Jefferson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Richard Jefferson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: LeBron James on Richard Jefferson, Channing Frye
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:LeBron, on the @RoadTrippinPod with Allie Clifton, Richard Jefferson and Channing Frye:

“I ain’t high-fivin’ nobody for the rest of my life after this.”

LeBron James on Richard Jefferson, Channing Frye, Mar 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Richard Jefferson, Kyle Korver, Channing Frye
item.description:
Celtics'Brad Stevens:

“Korver, Frye, Jefferson, those guys were playing the right way up 45 freaking points. Tremendous examples for us.”

Brad Stevens on Richard Jefferson, Kyle Korver, Channing Frye, May 20, 2017. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Richard Jefferson
item.description:
“Me, him and (Cavs forward Richard Jefferson). But R.J. is terrible, so we keep him away. He's not serious enough. Me and Luke are pretty serious about it.”

Tyronn Lue on Richard Jefferson, Dec 16, 2016. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Jeff Van Gundy on Richard Jefferson
item.description:
Jeff Van Gundy:

“Don’t talk about what you need to do to win. Do what you need to do to win. Richard Jefferson, great loose ball play and has always been a terrific finisher on the break.”

Jeff Van Gundy on Richard Jefferson, May 26, 2016. Source: Awful Announcing.
